_doc: Reference data for benchmarking the Castor pipeline against a B2B SaaS corporate-learning / L&D platform.

venture_under_test.name: Skillyard
venture_under_test.description: Skillyard is a B2B SaaS corporate learning and development platform for mid-market companies with 200-2000 employees building structured upskilling programs for technical and operations teams. We bundle a content library (technical, leadership, compliance), AI-driven learning paths, skills assessments, and integration with HRIS for completion tracking. Pricing: $25 per learner per month, billed annually. Target buyer: Chief Learning Officer, VP of People Development, and Director of L&D at mid-market companies investing in workforce development. We compete with Coursera Business, Udemy Business, LinkedIn Learning, Pluralsight, and Degreed. Differentiation: AI-generated learning paths personalized per role + skill-gap assessment, vs competitors' static catalog browsing model; price 30-40% below category median (per-learner monthly vs annual seat); skills-graph integration with Workday/SuccessFactors for promotion-readiness signals.
venture_under_test.category: B2B SaaS corporate learning / L&D platform

expected_pipeline_outputs._tam_note: Defensible US corporate L&D scoping: narrow $3-6B (mid-market 200-2000 emp segment), mid-narrow $8-15B (full SaaS LMS + content), broad $25-35B (US corporate e-learning total). Pipeline TAM mid acceptable in $3B-$35B range.
